article_A: Randomized controlled trial of a reading remediation program in 140 primary school children. Participants were allocated to intervention or control. Reading scores improved significantly in the intervention group. The program was delivered over twelve weeks by trained teachers. Outcomes were measured with a standardized reading test. Limitations include the short follow-up period and the single-site design.

article_D: This paper investigates machine learning methods for automatic essay scoring in higher education. We compare transformer architectures with feature-based baselines on a corpus of 12,000 essays. Results show that fine-tuned transformers outperform baselines by a wide margin. We discuss fairness implications and propose a calibration procedure.
